title: Price-loss decision desk
question: Which items lose the most margin to discounts, and what should we do about each one?
story: Discounts cost {total_loss} in the selected period; the list holds {items} items, {items:change} on the previous run.
questions: Which category lost the most to discounts last quarter?
How did the loss rate move by channel?

datasets.name: trend
datasets.sql: SELECT as_of_date, month, category, channel, region, loss, revenue, discounts FROM main.pricing.loss_trend

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, i.category, i.channel, i.region FROM main.pricing.loss_desk_out AS o JOIN main.pricing.items AS i ON i.item_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'
